An independent mouse demyelination study reports Wnt-Ror2 pathway inhibition suppressing JNK-associated spinal-neuron death and Wnt5a overexpression aggravating neurodegeneration. The route is retained as a composite ligand-receptor-to-intracellular-to-functional-output annotation while preserving the separate-study boundary.
